issue: The same integration and minimal request succeed synchronously, but the asynchronous invocation has no retrievable result.

test_context.purpose: Test Druid webhook transport using a minimal message, without procurement documents.
test_context.configuration: The cloned action was published. The required webhook fields were added to the GPT entity.
test_context.audit_log_observation: The user reports no corresponding asynchronous execution visible in the cloned connector audit log.
test_context.interpretation: The cause is not yet confirmed. The asynchronous acknowledgement alone does not establish successful execution of the connector.
test_context.evidence_note: Identifiers, URLs, parameters, response bodies and the original request below are preserved verbatim. The original request messages are in Spanish; a separate English translation is included for reference only and was not sent to Druid.

observations: The asynchronous POST returned HTTP 200 in 0.178 seconds, with the invocation ID as plain text.
Seven initial GET requests returned HTTP 404 over an approximately 60-second polling window.
Additional GET checks using responseContentType=text/plain and application/json also returned HTTP 404 for the same ID.
The separate synchronous POST, using the same integration, credentials and request body with asyncResponse=false, returned HTTP 200 in 2.543 seconds and the expected PRUEBA_ASYNC_OK response.
Polling used the exact invocation ID returned by the asynchronous POST; the polling loop did not repeat the POST.
secrets: No tokens, passwords or authentication headers are included.
requested_checks: Check whether the asynchronous job was queued and executed by the webhook service for this tenant.
Check where the asynchronous ResponseBody is stored and why GetGenericIntegrationResponse cannot find it.
Confirm the runtime version and any required configuration for GenericIntegration with asyncResponse=true.
Explain whether HTTP 404 with this message can represent a pending job, or indicates missing/expired response data in this environment.
